title: Overwatch Patch Notes – January 9, 2019
raw_text: January 9, 2019 Overwatch Patch Notes – January 9, 2019 A new patch is now live on PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes. To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum. BUG FIXES General Fixed a bug that prevented special event music for Ana’s Bastet Challenge from playing in the main menu Fixed a bug that prevented heroes from loading on the victory screen Fixed a bug that caused Wrecking Ball’s golden weapon to display incorrectly when using certain skins
